Consumer.title: Defective Samsung Phone — Consumer Forum Delhi, 2023
Consumer.authority: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Forum, Delhi
Consumer.desc: Buyer received a phone with motherboard defect. Forum ruled defect was manufacturing fault and ordered full replacement + compensation.

Consumer.title: IRCTC Train Delay — NCDRC, 2022
Consumer.desc: 14-hour train delay caused a family to miss a wedding. NCDRC held IRCTC liable for deficiency in service and awarded full compensation.

Consumer.title: Insurance Claim Rejection — State Commission Maharashtra, 2023
Consumer.desc: Insurance company wrongly rejected a cashless medical claim citing pre-existing condition. Commission ruled rejection was mala fide.

Consumer.title: Builder Flat Delay — NCDRC, 2021
Consumer.desc: Builder delayed possession by 4 years. NCDRC awarded full refund with compound interest at 10% p.a. and litigation costs.

Consumer.title: Online Shopping Fraud — Consumer Forum Bangalore, 2022
Consumer.desc: Flipkart seller sent a counterfeit product. Forum ordered full refund plus compensation for mental harassment.

RTI.title: PDS Beneficiary List RTI — CIC, 2022
RTI.desc: PIO failed to provide BPL ration card list within 30 days. CIC imposed maximum penalty and ordered disclosure.

RTI.title: Road Construction Fund RTI — State IC Gujarat, 2023
RTI.desc: Municipal corporation refused to share ward-level expense details. Commission ordered full disclosure with penalty on officer.

RTI.title: Government Job Selection RTI — CIC, 2021
RTI.desc: UPSC refused to share answer sheets. Supreme Court upheld CIC and ruled candidates have right to access their own evaluated sheets.

Tenant / Housing.title: Illegal Eviction Injunction — Delhi HC, 2022
Tenant / Housing.desc: Landlord attempted forcible eviction without proper notice. Court granted interim injunction within a week and awarded litigation costs.

Tenant / Housing.title: Security Deposit Refund — Rent Court Mumbai, 2023
Tenant / Housing.desc: Landlord withheld 10-month security deposit without justification. Court ordered full refund with 9% interest.

Tenant / Housing.title: Unlawful Rent Hike — Rent Control Appellate, Pune, 2022
Tenant / Housing.desc: Landlord raised rent by 40% in violation of Rent Control Act cap. Appellate authority reversed hike and ordered refund of excess paid.

Labour.title: Unlawful Termination — Labour Court Mumbai, 2023
Labour.desc: Employee terminated without chargesheet or domestic inquiry. Tribunal ruled termination void and ordered reinstatement with back wages.

Labour.title: PF Deduction Fraud — EPFO Appellate, 2022
Labour.desc: Employer was deducting PF but not depositing. Appellate authority penalised employer and directed full PF transfer to employee.

Labour.title: Maternity Leave Denial — High Court Karnataka, 2022
Labour.desc: Private employer refused to grant 26-week maternity leave under Maternity Benefit Act 2017. Court ruled denial was illegal.

Criminal.title: Bail Grant in Cheque Bounce — Magistrate Court, 2023
Criminal.desc: Accused arrested in Section 138 NI Act case. Immediate bail was granted as offence is compoundable and no flight risk was shown.

Criminal.title: FIR Quashing — Bombay HC, 2022
Criminal.desc: FIR filed for civil property dispute disguised as criminal matter. High Court quashed it invoking Section 482 CrPC as abuse of process.

General.title: Credit Card Fraud Recovery — Consumer Forum Chennai, 2022
General.desc: Unauthorized transactions on credit card. Bank initially refused. Forum ordered full reversal plus ₹10,000 for mental harassment.

General.title: Hospital Medical Negligence — NCDRC, 2022
General.desc: Hospital performed wrong surgery on patient. NCDRC held hospital and surgeon jointly liable and awarded comprehensive compensation.
